老农车上跑下来的小猪，跑的很快: A fast-running little piglet that jumped off the old farmer's cart.
他那带有海盗标志的路障让他比普通水手僵尸强两倍: His pirate-emblazoned traffic cone makes him twice as tough as a regular Swashbuckler Zombie.
